sobre-mi.texto_acerdeDe: I am a developer specialized in teamwork and implementing effective technological solutions. I have experience in both collaborative work and individual tasks. My focus is on content management systems like WordPress and Joomla, as well as frameworks like Laravel. Additionally, I am an expert in troubleshooting and configuring email. I am passionate about creating websites that offer an exceptional user experience.
